tasks.prompt: Hvað er að gerast á myndinni? Skrifaðu minnst 5 setningar.
tasks.promptTranslation: What is happening in the picture? Write at least 5 sentences.
tasks.imageDescription: A busy supermarket scene: a woman pushing a cart with groceries, a man comparing two products in the cereal aisle, a cashier scanning items at the register, and a child reaching for candy near the checkout. Shopping bags and price signs are visible.

taskCompletion.description: Does the response describe the picture content? Does it have at least 5 sentences? Does it cover multiple elements of the scene?

vocabulary.description: A2-appropriate vocabulary: shopping items, supermarket areas, people, actions. Uses varied words.

grammar.description: Basic Icelandic sentence structure. Subject-verb agreement. Correct use of present tense for describing what's happening.

coherence.description: Sentences relate to each other and build a description. Some logical flow.

tasks.sampleAnswer: Á myndinni er matvöruverslun. Kona er með innkaupakörfu og velur vörur. Maður er að skoða morgunkorn í hillunni. Við kassann er afgreiðslukona að skanna vörur. Lítið barn teygir sig eftir nammi við kassann. Það eru verðmiðar á hillum.

tasks.prompt: Vinnan mín. Skrifaðu um vinnuna þína eða vinnuna sem þú vilt fá. Skrifaðu minnst 5 setningar.
tasks.promptTranslation: My work. Write about your job or the job you would like to get. Write at least 5 sentences.

taskCompletion.description: Does the response describe work or desired work? Does it have at least 5 sentences? Does it cover relevant aspects?

vocabulary.description: A2-appropriate vocabulary: work-related words, time expressions, people at work.

grammar.description: Basic sentence structure. Present tense. Time expressions. Basic connectors.

coherence.description: Logical flow describing work life. Sentences connect naturally.

tasks.sampleAnswer: Ég vinn í verslun í miðbænum. Ég byrja klukkan níu á morgnana og hætti klukkan fimm. Ég þjóna viðskiptavinum og set vörur á hillur. Yfirmaðurinn minn er góður og samstarfsfólkið er vingjarnlegt. Mér finnst vinnan góð en stundum erfið. Ég vil læra meira og fá betri vinnu í framtíðinni.
